description: Wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into approval_workflow on port 8780. snow_connector.py is a protected file — this directive creates a new companion module that consumes snow_connector outputs. MUST use write_service (:8772) for all DB reads/writes. MUST check service_health for snow_connector before processing. MUST query mcp_server_registry for verdict before inserting mcp_submissions. MUST call approval_workflow API (POST :8780/submissions) when SNOW ticket arrives. MUST NOT make direct HTTP to snow_connector daemon. MUST NOT write to mcp_submissions without verifying verdict != HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED and verdict != KNOWN_THREAT. Spec reference: Section 5 inter-daemon communication rules.
